about: 星戦のSEを ElevenLabs の効果音生成で作るための計画。scripts/generate_sfx_elevenlabs.js が読む。status: new＝まだ無い場面のSE（作ってからゲームに配線する）、existing＝今あるSEの作り直し候補。prompt は英語（生成の指示）、use は日本語（どこで鳴るか）。
style: Sound effect for the battle screen of a Japanese dark-fantasy card game whose interface is black lacquer with thin gold lines. Restrained, elegant and clean, built from traditional Japanese sounds (taiko, koto, shakuhachi, shamisen, wooden hyoshigi clappers, suzu bells, temple gong, singing bowl, paper and silk). Dry and close, short tail, no music loop, no voice, no melody longer than a few notes.
